gbm_population_evidence.quote: other tumor types including, but not limited to glioblastoma, NSCLC and anal cancer

candidate_evidence.quote: Blood samples, tumor biopsy specimens and ascites samples will be collected at different time points

source_quote.quote: aiming to describe the PD-1 (programmed death) expression in T cells (T lymphocytes) in different solid tumors

coder_notes: Translational sampling cohort study; the only registered intervention is collection of blood, biopsy and ascites samples, patients receive anticancer treatment as standard care (no study drug). Glioblastoma is named among the conditions and eligible tumour types. Biomarker is PD-1 expression on T cells (closest enum is PD_L1); it is an outcome, not an entry requirement.
